Unit 42 reported that attackers leveraged agentic AI platforms for post-exploitation activity after abusing PHP vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619.

Targeting a European government entity, they accessed password hashes and MFA secrets within two hours, established an NTLM-relay tunnel into Active Directory, and attempted Domain Admin privilege escalation.
